seo.title: Sloane Whitaker | Scottsdale Luxury Homes and Real Estate
seo.description: Scottsdale luxury real estate with Sloane Whitaker: private showings and desert modern homes in Paradise Valley, North Scottsdale and Arcadia.

hero.headline: Scottsdale homes, sold quietly and well.
hero.sub: Luxury real estate for buyers and sellers who'd rather not be marketed at. Private showings, honest pricing, and an agent who picks up the phone.

me.headline: Twenty years in the desert, and still in love with the light.
story: I moved to Scottsdale from Chicago for one winter in 2006 and never went back. Before real estate I spent ten years as an interior designer, which is why I'll tell you exactly what a room needs before it's photographed, and what it doesn't.
Most of my sales never hit a yard sign. My clients value discretion, and I protect it: private showings, qualified buyers only, and no surprises at the closing table.

beats.alt: White great room with a wall of glass and a hill view
beats.title: Sell the view, not the furniture
beats.text: Buyers in this price range are buying the light and the mountains. We edit the room down until the windows do the talking.

beats.alt: Luxury kitchen with a large island
beats.title: Every surface tells the truth
beats.text: Appliance brands, stone type and the year of the remodel go on the sheet. Luxury buyers ask, and the answers should already be there.

beats.title: Calm sells
beats.text: We photograph it at golden hour with nothing on the nightstands. It's the room buyers picture themselves waking up in.

beats.alt: Pool and fire pit at dusk
beats.title: Evenings outside are the product
beats.text: Scottsdale is lived outdoors from October to May. We show the yard at dusk, with the fire pit lit and the pool lights on.

faq.q: Can you sell my home without public marketing?
faq.a: Yes. Many of my sales are private: showings only to qualified buyers, and no public open houses. We'll talk through what you give up and gain either way.
It's negotiable and agreed in writing before any work starts.

faq.q: Do I need to sign anything to tour homes?
faq.a: Yes, a short written buyer agreement, as the rules now require. It spells out what I'm paid and who pays it.

faq.q: Do you help with second homes?
faq.a: Often. Many of my buyers winter here. I can connect you with property managers who look after a home while you're away.
